title: YieldArgs
description: Fixed worker envelope only. Never compare result to output_example. Sole-call yield and unique topic keys are handler checks.

result.description: Any JSON value, including text. Required when completed; no shape validation, coercion, or repair against the output example.

notes.description: Optional supplementary completion notes saved to a file; mandatory inline blocker explanation when reason is blocked.

JITed_history.description: Project-local topic updates retained for later Flash context, not forwarded to the parent agent. [] means no update.
